messages:
sarah_sales: Heads-up — Auriga Inc sent a security package: CAIQ PDF + request for an authenticated vuln scan against our POC environment. They want answers + scan this week. Attaching CAIQ and scan creds to vault. Can security own intake and timeline? Deal target EOW. @raj_security @emily_privacy :exclamation:

raj_security: Quick clarifying q's — full CAIQ completion or reference answers? Is any customer PII expected in the POC? We need scan scope (hosts/ports) and if they will provide auth creds with least privilege.

jordan_se: We can spin a POC env quickly. I can provision creds and whitelist IPs. What IP ranges should security expect to see? Also — any pricing impact if we run an authenticated scan?

emily_privacy: If PII is in scope, we need DPA updates and an NDA signed (even for POC). Also require a simple dataflow diagram showing sample data in the POC.

raj_security: Operational note — security-ops will need 48h to schedule an authenticated scan + a remediation review slot. We can complete CAIQ template (standard answers) in ~2 business days. Authenticated scans are sensitive and we treat them as a professional service add-on for deals that need expedited scheduling — will confirm pricing with finance. For IP whitelisting, we typically ask for the scanning IPs (example):
```
35.198.120.0/24
34.96.0.0/16
```
and a 2hr scan window.

sarah_sales: Customer says templated/reference CAIQ answers are fine. They claim no production data — only synthetic sample records. They want the scan Thur morning. Can we expedite? Deal pressure is high.

raj_security: We can try to prioritize but need approvals: @emily_privacy confirm whether synthetic sample still requires DPA addendum? Also looping in @alan_sre for whitelisting.

alan_sre: Ack. We can whitelist once ticket + IPs are provided. Example firewall command we use for internal ops:
```
gcloud compute firewall-rules create allow-auriga-poc-scan --allow=tcp:22,tcp:443 --source-ranges=35.198.120.0/24 --network=prod-poc-net
```
Will need exact CIDRs and ticket.

emily_privacy: Even synthetic customer-like data can trigger privacy reviews depending on sensitivity. I'll prepare a limited-scope addendum template for signatures (fast). Legal may waive full DPA for test data but we need the addendum signed before auth creds are shared.

raj_security: Pricing update (prelim): authenticated scan + remediation review = +$5k (one-time) for priority scheduling. If they don't accept, we can offer a light unauthenticated external scan for free but it won't cover auth-level checks. Sarah — confirm if customer is open to the add-on.

sarah_sales: They're price-sensitive. I'll ask to bundle it into the POC at no additional cost first. If they push, I'll offer the paid add-on. Meanwhile can we run a light unauth scan to show progress?

raj_security: Yes — we can run a non-auth external scan as a quick option (limited surface). For auth scan we need creds in the vault and scope locked down (no DB shell, no root). If they insist on auth, limit scope = app/web layers only.

jordan_se: For creds, send them via secure vault request: https://vault.redwood.internal/requests — include ticket #. I can provision service account creds and rotate after scan.

sarah_sales: Customer responded: ok to pay $5k if we sign the addendum and schedule same-week. They're ready to sign. I'll push for the addendum now. Contact is anna@auriga.com.

raj_security: Assigning intake to @emily_privacy + security-ops. Proposed timeline: CAIQ answers by Tue EOD, authenticated scan Thu morning, remediation review Fri. If finance signs off on add-on, we prioritize Thu.

emily_privacy: On it. Created ticket SEC-9876. I'll draft the addendum and schedule a 30m call with the customer to confirm scope. Need point of contact and preferred scan window. Sarah, please add contact details in the ticket.

sarah_sales: Added contact + uploaded CAIQ.pdf to the ticket and requested secure-vault entry for creds. Moving this to the SEC-9876 thread. Thanks.

security-bot: Ticket SEC-9876 created and assigned to emily_privacy. SLA: 5 business days.

raj_security: Great — keep updates in this thread only. If we get sign-off, we will confirm whitelists and schedule. :thumbsup:
